question.prompt: A slope has a vertical height of \(3\) meters and a horizontal distance of \(4\) meters. What is the length along the slope, in meters?

solutions.explanation: The vertical height and horizontal distance are perpendicular, so the slope is the hypotenuse of a right triangle. By the Pythagorean theorem, its length is \(\sqrt{3^2+4^2}=\sqrt{25}=5\) meters.
solutions.title: Model the slope as a hypotenuse
